notes.title: Launching the Touching Grass Simulator demo!
notes.content:
Today, the world can finally stay indoors, and touch some grass!

Now what is next? Here's the plans for everything that will be happening until the steam next fest!

[h1]Flowers[/h1]
There's different kinds of flowers with different effects!

[h2]Yield type flowers[/h2]
These are flowers that give you better chances of increasing the yield. However, in return they slow down the growth rate:
[list]
[*] Daisy - 2% chance to gain an additional blade of grass. 10% decrease to growth speed.
[*] Dandelion - 5% chance to gain an additional blade of grass. 15% decrease to growth speed.
[*] Sunflower - 10% chance to gain an additional blade of grass. 20% decrease to growth speed.
[*] Mycelia - this special mushroom can only be planted in caves. 25% chance to gain an additional blade of grass. No growth speed deficit (this automatically comes with the cave region).
[/list]
[table]    [tr]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/74bee2d8be94637c1b46e0831dfdfa2cd9ab58c3.png[/img][/td]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/fad7eff2f489ffa15bce3320bac1e6780dfb6108.png[/img][/td]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/c4f72348a3cfc96be178eda5a4d517e5b703f1bd.png[/img][/td]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/5056ff7f0692815302935abbca451b1f3316cb5a.png[/img][/td]    [/tr][/table]


[h2]Growth type flowers[/h2]
These are flowers that decrease the time it takes to grow. These limit the amount of total allowed buffs on nearby grass.
[list]
[*] Lavender - Increases growth rate by 15x, affects up to 10 grass blades, limits foreign buffs to 10.
[*] Bluebell - Increases growth rate by 30x, affects up to 5 grass blades, limits foreign buffs to 6.
[*] Tulip - Increases growth rate by 50x, affects up to 3 grass blades, limits foreign buffs to 4.
[*] Lillypad - this special lily can only be planted on the water. Increases growth rate by 90x, affects up to 5 grass blades, limits foreign buffs to 2.
[/list]
[table]    [tr]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/03269632e522e51eb22593cfbe2c6c3a755fffa6.png[/img][/td]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/26d339bdd890b8765b348ad7c2bc8dcb20ff7121.png[/img][/td]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/e95d9adc5c8a1ae21ae6a1528f047468549a0050.png[/img][/td]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/f1c49d46f7102caaf00144934e5ebe42603a3196.png[/img][/td]    [/tr][/table]

[h2]Haggle type flowers[/h2]
Lexie likes flowers. Surely she will give you a better price if you make it pretty around her shop.
These flowers grow more powerful if they have more concurrently growing grass around it (e.g. Peony charms: 0 grass blades = 0%, 1 grass blade = 3.3...%, 2 grass blades = 6.6...%, 3 grass blades = 10%).
[list]
[*] Peony charm - 10% better prices max, 0 - 5 growing grass blades, decreses grass growth speed by 80%.
[*] Iridescent orchid - 15% better prices max, 4 - 10 growing grass blades, decreses grass growth speed by 80%.
[*] Rose blossom - 20% better prices max, 8 - 20 growing grass blades, decreses grass growth speed by 80%.
[/list]
All of these are considered special and need to be dropped as a bonus drop. Their effects only stack on each other (meaning peony + orchid + rose) but not on themself (no rose + rose). Therefor the highest increase you can get is 45%.
[table]    [tr]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/4d60daa810eb75b39ec7ab6231a218f8b684b452.png[/img][/td]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/532c350ea56359b220a06ffb87c7a5f78141dff0.png[/img][/td]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/b55c10a43adce576806207172f95558f317b3c10.png[/img][/td]    [/tr][/table]

[h2]Bonus drop flowers[/h2]
These are the only way to receive a special seed. Special seeds are e.g. Mycelia or water Lilies.
[list]
[*] Chamomile - 10% chance for a special seed, 10% decrease to growth speed.
[*] Poppy - 20% chance for a special seed, 20% decrease to growth speed.
[*] Foxglove - 30% chance for a special seed 30% decrease to growth speed.
[/list]
[table]    [tr]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/39d8be1934655803c67e558d1672f3c995899c8f.png[/img][/td]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/1266bf7c9a2aa043a4e5621b3a834b3bac90df3e.png[/img][/td]        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517750/74f6437269c386b81dd0b203404d5f60eaa3c9bc.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

[h1]Water, caves and mountains[/h1]
A plant can receive water from three sources:
[olist]
[*] Watering can - use this to water a plant that is far from any other water source.
[*] Ponds - Static places that have a muddy terrain around them. This muddy terrain is considered as watered!
[*] Rain - The more it rains, the more water comes down. Details further below.
[/olist]
The watering can and pond will simply consider the plant "watered" and have no effect on one another. In fact, they have the exact same effect of increasing growth rate by 10x.
Rain can increase the growth rate by up to 10x as well, but only for non watered plants.

[h1]Caves[/h1]
Caves may have water in them, but by default nothing but fungi can grow in there. No light means no photosynthesis, means no grass! For this you want to use spotlights. They can illuminate a small area and, depending on their strength, return some growth speed to the grass. Most flowers are completely incapable of growing in caves.

[h1]Mountains[/h1]
Mountains are pretty straight forward. Their challenge is to climb them up and down every time you need to be there. There are no debuffs on mountains, but some buffs only obtainable high up!

[h1]Rain[/h1]
So heres the ddep dive on weather we've all been waiting for:
[h2]Weather[/h2]
The weather is set to change once every 6 minutes. The new weather you can have is based on your current weather:
If its sunny: 50% chance to stay sunny; 50% chance to start a light rain.
If there is light rain: 33.3...% chance to stay with light rain; 33.3...% chance for medium rain; 33.3...% chance to switch back to sunny.
If there is medium rain: 60% chance to go back to light rain; 20% chance to advance to heavy rain; 20% chance to stay with medium rain.
If there is heavy rain: 80% chance to go back to medium rain; 20% chance to stay with heavy rain.

Internally, these are represented with a floating point value going from 0 - 1:
[list]
[*] 0.0 = Sunny
[*] 0.0 - 0.32999... = Light rain
[*] 0.33... - 0,66999... = Medium rain
[*]0.67 - 1 = Heavy rain
[/list]
You can use these to approximate your current rain (de)buffs.

[h2]Rain (De)Buffs[/h2]
If the plant is not considered as watered:
[list]
[*] 0 - 0.5 = 1x - 10x growth
[*] 0.5 - 0.75 = 10x - 1x growth
[*] 0.75 - 0.9 = 1x - 0x growth
[*] > 0.9 drown
[/list]
If the plant IS considered as watered:
[list]
[*] 0 - 0.3299.. = 1x
[*] 0.33 - 0.6699 = 1x - 0x
[*] > 0.67 = drown
[/list]

So as you can see, it is always advisable to shield watered plants from rain!

notes.title: Water barrel & flower changes
notes.content:
[h1]Added[/h1]
Flowers now by default reduce growth speed. This depends on the flower. 
0.9x for daisies. This is only additive for now. (Formula: 1/SUM(1/0.9))
A positive value simply adds. e.g. 1.25 multiplier on 2 plants = 1.5x multiplier.
Added a rain barrel that gets filled up by rain.
You can refill your watering can at the rain barrel.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
Consecutive bonus chance now decreases by 5x (10x before). 
e.g.:
before: chance = 100% - 2nd chance = 10% - 3rd chance = 1%
now: chance = 100% - 2nd chance = 20% - 3rd chance = 4%
This should make it way more possible to get multiple grassblades easily.
Fixed an issue where flowers would appear green permanently.
Fixed an issue where flowers wouldnt load from your savefile.
A flower only affects grass when it's fully grown.
The watering can can now only hold 10 seconds of water.
The watering can now doesnt refill after a restart.

[previewyoutube=sic-ua1sad8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Internal shop improvements & placeable flowers
notes.content:
[h1]New[/h1]
Flowers that affect grass now glow green when planting the grass.
Added daisy seeds to the shop.
The store is now "smart". That means it keeps track of what you selected so far and doesn't select you any more items if your available money isn't high enough.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
Fixed multiple issues with the new preview system.
Fixed flickering of Marijuhana preview.
Removed ability to pick up grass when holding seeds/the watering can.
A grass blade is only sold for 1.15$.
A flower now only buffs for 2%. Flower buffs stack additively (2 flowers = 4% buff, 60 flowers = 120% buff).
In the case of a 120% buff you have a 100% chance for a second and a 12% chance for a third grass blade. This will continue being lowered until you miss a chance for a grass blade.

This lays the ground work to add more flowers. In the future a new flower shouldnt be more work than defining it's pure existence

notes.title: Minor Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where saved sound settings wouldnt apply on load.
Fixed an issue where the inventory bar would appear as if it selected an item but didnt actually select any on load.
[strike]Hopefully[/strike] Improved performance a little when grass is growing. (Should be multithreaded now)

notes.title: Steam store page now live!
notes.content:
Today, Steam finally approved my request to publish the store page! Let's take this opportunity to review the current state of development. Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!

[h1]What is the current state of the game?[/h1]
The game is fully playable. It's short, but the core gameplay loop is functional. Many mechanics are already implemented on a technical side and now just need content. This includes items in the in game shop, various buffs/debuffs. etc.
So what is really [b]in it[/b] at this point:
[list]
[*] Purchase grass seeds. Plant grass. Watch it grow. Harvest it. Sell it.
[*] Grass grows in 100 seconds as a base value currently.
[*] A single daisy. It gives you a 5% chance to obtain extra grass when harvesting grass that is planted near it.
[*] You start with a watering can.
[*] Alternatively, you can plant near the small lake in the marshy area.
[*] Both watering methods set the grass to a 'watered' state, decreasing growth time tenfold. Meaning it grows in 10 seconds only!
[*] Weather
[list]
[*] Sunshine
[*] Light rain
[*] Medium rain
[*] Heavy rain
[*] Internally, rain intensity is represented by a value from 0 to 1, with 0 being sunshine and 1 the heaviest rain.
[*] Grass growth accelerates with light rain but slows with medium to heavy rain. Excessive moisture can 'drown' your grass, halting its growth.
[*] This drowning process starts earlier with plants that are considered watered. Watered plants do not get any speed boost from rain and immediately lose growth-speed even in light rain.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]What am I working on right now?[/h1]
I'm working on implementing DOTS to improve efficiency. Currently, I can plant about 10,000 blades of grass without experiencing lag. Some testers had their limits down to 1,000 blades only. That of course is not enough so I'm trying to gain performance early before the code gets too convoluted. This requires me to learn a completely new technology, making it a significant task.

[h1]Okay, but this isn't gonna last forever, so what's next?[/h1]
My top priority will always be addressing simple-to-fix and game-breaking bugs. And after that the plan are the following features:
[olist]
[*] In-game shop items. Add more seed types, some buildings, and of course functionality for them. Including but not limited to:
[list]
[*] Flower seeds: Allowing you to plant flowers strategically to provide specific buffs.
[*] Various buffs: Enhancing sale value with certain flowers, increasing growth speed with others, and introducing higher-tier flowers (e.g., sunflowers providing a 10% yield boost instead of 5%).
[*] Building plans: Introducing new structures with unique functionalities.
[*] Carports: Protecting your grass from rain.
[*] Rain barrels: Providing a convenient way to refill your watering can.
[*] Lamps and other light sources: Eliminating debuffs caused by darkness.
[/list]
[*] As mentioned just above - various debuffs. Starting with the existing drowning debuff from rain, going to others like lesser quality grass from being planted in shadows, or inability to grow due to being planted on bad soil/in caves.
[*] These debuffing places will have other qualities. Caves will get the ability to plant special mushrooms, giving stronger buffs to nearby grass than flowers. Bad soil might not be affected by drowning.
[*] Mountains and caves. Some flowers only grow up high. Others only in caves. Each come with their own challenges.
[*] Re do most UI elements. Right now they only serve the function to work. Most of them aren't particularly pretty, so a rework for them is also in mind.
[*] Engaging with the community to gather ideas and implement your suggestions. This game is very much open for any feedback any of you might have. The best way to interact is by joining the Discord server: https://discord.gg/bz5hP2P
[/olist]
And as a last thing, but something that might not happen depending on who is going to play the game: Speedrunning integrations. I love speedrunning. I love minmaxing. So why not foster a community that does both at once. So, if there is [b]any[/b] kind of demand there will be in game features for speedrunners, like connecting the leaderboards, in game timers, and whatever you guys come up with for categories.
